title: Talent Branding Specialist
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

We're currently seeking a dynamic Talent Branding Specialist. You will play a crucial role in shaping our company's employer brand, ensuring that we attract and retain top\-tier talent. We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

description:
**Job Title:** ***Front Desk Manager (sales) – Music Academy***

***Location:*** *Borewell Road, Whitefield*

* **Tuesday to Saturday:** 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and organized **Front Desk Manager** to oversee front office operations, manage student inquiries, handle admissions sales, ensure timely lead follow\-ups, and support overall academy management. **Key Responsibilities** Front Desk \& Reception Management

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
LSEG offers essential platforms, financial data services and trading venues for various clients such as businesses, governments, and investors around the globe.


The real\-time market data, indices, analytics, and news services LSEG supplies allows traders and investors understand market conditions and trends. We deliver the infrastructure, data, and analytics that market participants rely on to make confident, informed investment decisions.


LSEG is dedicated to empowering economies and enabling sustainable growth by incorporating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into its operations and offerings.


**Our People:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.


We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.


We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.


As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with significant careers.

  

  

**Role Summary:**

In this role, you will be joining our Service Excellence team within Application Operations, Corporate Technology (CT) as a Support Engineer


**What You Will be Doing:**

* Take end\-to\-end Ownership of Application Support for Production issues resolution.
* Possess hand\-on experience in ServiceNow, including incident management, problem resolution and workflow automation to enhance IT service delivery.
* Raises complex problems to the L3 level of expertise within organization, along with observations from investigative and diagnostic assessments.
* Co\-ordinating in the investigation of repeated technical issues affecting user system and seeing through to resolution.
* Ensuring an acceptable level of IT operations performance and error risk in line with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Provide some periodical and/or emergency support (i.e. on\-call support), as may be needed from time\-to\-time.
* Advance incidents/failures to Level 3 Support or Capability in line with the defined escalation process and drive the closure within the SLAs.
* Provide regular and high\-quality updates to the customer on the progress on the incidents, including SLA breaches.
* Continuously review operating metrics and data to see opportunities to improve.

**What You will Bring:**  

  



**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience providing support and maintenance for Salesforce environments.
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ and Sales Cloud is preferred.
* Salesforce CPQ support is a core responsibility of this position. Candidates must be willing to undergo training and invest time in learning CPQ processes and functionality. The successful candidate will be expected to develop sufficient expertise to independently handle CPQ\-related tickets, user requests, and support activities.
* One or more Salesforce.com certifications (e.g., CPQ, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Community).
* Knowledge and experience with both Salesforce Classic and Lightning UI's.
* Experience integrating and maintaining salesforce with third\-party systems.
* Knowledge of Salesforce platform standard and custom capabilities (e.g., standard, and custom fields, validation rules, formulas, page layouts and record pages, custom object and relationships, approvals, and security).
* Knowledge of Salesforce platform automation abilities and practical application of Process Builders, Flows, Visualforce, APEX programming, Force.com APIs, REST API's and Web Services.
* Experience conducting QA Tests on changes to Salesforce.com deployment including handling multiple sandbox instances.
* Understanding of the SDLC and agile delivery methodology.
* Experience working with databases and data, performing data cleanup, and/or data manipulation and migration to and from Salesforce.com.
* Have stayed ahead of new SFDC features and functionality and have provided. recommendations for process improvements.
* 2\+ Years of experience in a Support Technical role.
* 1 year experience in Salesforce CPQ cloud would be advantage.
* The team provides support coverage to clients across multiple regions on a 24/5 basis. This role is primarily aligned to US business hours and will participate in an on\-call rotation, including occasional weekend support as required.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Work closely with senior and junior engineers in Service Excellence Team and coordinate the efforts with lead and manager of the team.
* Must interact with global teams in time zones spanning UK, US, APAC areas.
* Resolve customer service issues and thoughtfully handle complex customer service problems.
* Lead customers: expectations and experience in a way that results in high customer satisfaction.
* Assist with the design and delivery of product and other technical training.
* Review support cases for technical and troubleshooting accuracy.
* Define and describe technical standard processes.
* You will also be asked to create knowledge base materials dedicated towards operational efficiency while also empowering and enabling the Salesforce community.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex workflows rules, validation rules, formulas, custom workflow, automated approvals, process builder, page layouts, custom fields/objects, and other Salesforce.com customizations based on industry guidelines as well as business needs.
* Develop highly interactive UI using Lightning Design System, Visual force, JavaScript, and jQuery technologies.
* Ongoing systems administration, configuration, end\-user support and maintenance of Salesforce.com and other related tools
* Create/maintain user accounts and interact with end\-users to fix and resolve issues and questions.
* Day to day maintenance and support of Salesforce including complex product and pricing rules and guided selling workflows.
* Solve and fix defects for planned releases and production issues, research and find opportunities to apply SFDC standard processes, guidelines to improve system productivity, scaling, and monitoring.
* Understanding of Incident Management, Problem Management processes.

title: LMS Administrator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an organized and customer\-focused **LMS Administrator** to support the day\-to\-day administration and learner experience of an enterprise Learning Management System.

The role involves supporting learners and content teams, troubleshooting LMS\-related issues, setting up courses and learning plans, performing testing before launches, and ensuring learning requests are completed accurately within defined SLAs.

The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with an LMS, application/technical support, customer support, or similar operational environment and should be comfortable learning new technology platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first\-line support to learners and internal users for LMS\-related queries and issues.
* Troubleshoot course access, enrollment, learning\-plan, completion and other platform\-related issues.
* Administer day\-to\-day LMS activities including course and learning\-plan setup, updates and maintenance.
* Assemble and configure learning courses and programs based on requirements from content teams.
* Manage support requests and resolve issues within defined SLA timelines.
* Use ticketing/incident\-management systems to track, update and close support requests.
* Execute functional testing across browsers and platforms as part of course and feature go\-live activities.
* Identify issues during testing and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
* Support the rollout of new LMS capabilities and platform enhancements.
* Gather learner feedback and identify recurring issues or opportunities to improve the learner experience.
* Create and maintain self\-service resources, FAQs and basic support documentation.
* Work closely with Business System Analysts, content teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy while managing multiple requests and priorities.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within LMS operations.

**Required Skills**

* 6 months–4 years of experience in **LMS administration, LMS support, application support, technical support, customer support or a similar operational role**.
* Hands\-on experience with any LMS platform is preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation.
* Ability to work within defined SLAs and manage multiple requests simultaneously.
* Good attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Comfortable learning and working with new technology platforms.

**Good to Have**

* Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) experience.
* ServiceNow or other ticketing/incident\-management tools.
* Adobe Captivate or other e\-learning/content\-authoring tools.
* Experience with UAT, functional testing or cross\-browser testing.
* Exposure to enterprise applications or SaaS platforms.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - ServiceNow
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst, under the direct supervision of the Onshore ServiceNow QA expert, is responsible for ensuring the quality of ServiceNow implementations and enhancements within the organization. The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 8\+ years of experience in developing comprehensive test plans, test suites, and executing test cases, with a strong emphasis on database validation
* 7\+ years of experience in QA testing, with at least 5 years specifically focused on ServiceNow
* 7\+ years of experience in ensuring test traceability, linking requirements to functional deliveries
* 4\+ years of experience working in the HR, healthcare, finance, or banking domains, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with multivendor teams
* 3\+ years of experience in automating test processes using Selenium or other open\-source automation tools

* 2\+ years of experience in managing defects, including triaging, brainstorming, retesting, and reporting

* ServiceNow Certified Testing Specialist (CTS)

* Proven solid written and verbal communication skills
* Proven to be proactive, decisive, and action\-oriented approach to work
* Proven excellent interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and team\-oriented mindset
* Proven ability to clearly articulate requirements into comprehensive test cases and ensure thorough test coverage across different teams
* Proven ability to manage and deliver multiple projects simultaneously

  

Leverage enterprise\-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation by streamlining workflows and automating repetitive tasks. Evaluate emerging trends to drive continuous improvement and strategic innovation

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone.
